title: Zesty Filipino Sweet Rice Flour Chapssalgaru Bistek
description: A tangy and springy Filipino dish featuring sweet rice flour chapssalgaru, braised in a flavorful sauce and served in a scallop shell, perfect for a romantic dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the sweet rice flour and water to form a dough.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces and shape each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a thin disk.
Heat a non-stick pan over medium heat and cook the disks for 2 minutes on each side.
In a separate pan, combine the coconut milk, fish sauce, lime juice, garlic, and ginger.
Bring the sauce to a boil and then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the cooked disks to the sauce and simmer for an additional 2 minutes.
Season the sauce with salt and pepper to taste.
Arrange the scallops in a scallop shell and spoon the sauce and disks over the top.
